channel.title: The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine (thecenterformichigan.net)

item.title: Grow Michigan’s economy? Many pledges, few plans at gubernatorial forum
item.description: Top candidates for governor offered a handful of ideas to jumpstart Michigan’s economy. Among them: Expand a ‘transformation brownfield’ tax capture program for developers, and ‘take a blowtorch to bureaucracy.’

item.title: Opinion | Investing in tuition-free college can be a good economic bet for Michigan
item.description: Having more educated workers strengthens communities, making it easier to attract new businesses and enabling existing employers to improve productivity and expand.

item.title: Want shorter lines on Election Day? It’s a science, and selfie stations help
item.description: Waiting in line to vote stinks. Some states have figured out how to make it better.

item.title: Feds take another step toward decision on Line 5 tunnel
item.description: The US Army Corps released an environmental review Friday that is the last step toward issuing key permits for the Line 5 tunnel.

item.title: Bridge Michigan News Quiz, Feb 6: Hip, hip, hooray for trivia
item.description: Another week of winter, another week of news: Have you been paying attention?

item.title: Michigan residents with degrees, skills certificates rises, but state ranking falls
item.description: Michigan’s overall postsecondary educational attainment has grown since the state set a goal of 60% of residents having a credential by 2030. But the state’s national ranking has fallen.

item.title: Michigan governor hopefuls clash on free student meals, ICE at schools
item.description: Democrat Jocelyn Benson said she’d use ‘every tool’ to keep ICE out of Michigan schools. That debate is a ‘sideshow’ that won’t fix education woes, argued Republican Mike Cox.

item.title: Bridge Listens Lunch Break: What issues matter most to Michiganders
item.description: Join members of Bridge Michigan’s politics team as they talk about the issues readers want the candidates focused on during this 2026 election cycle.

item.title: Michigan athletes go for gold in Winter Olympics. Who and when to watch
item.description: More than a dozen athletes with Michigan ties qualified for the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy. The state is particularly well represented in ice dancing and hockey.

item.title: Opinion | The youth literacy crisis is a threat to the nation’s foundation
item.description: Literacy achievements come about through a fierce commitment to evidence-based practices and hard work by teachers, students, and families. They are proof that all students can read when they are afforded the proper resources.
